scripts.test: node --test viqui/tests/*.test.mjs && bun run --filter 'viqui-*-typescript' test && uv run --package no-thin-wrapper-python pytest -c viqui/rules/no-thin-wrapper/pyproject.toml viqui/rules/no-thin-wrapper/py/test && uv run --package no-stateless-class-python pytest -c viqui/rules/no-stateless-class/pyproject.toml viqui/rules/no-stateless-class/py/test
scripts.lint: biome check . && uv run ruff check viqui && bun run --filter 'viqui-*-typescript' typecheck && bun run --filter viqui-shared typecheck && bun run lint:dependencies
scripts.lint:dependencies: depcruise --config viqui/dependency-cruiser.cjs viqui/rules viqui/shared && uv run lint-imports --config viqui/import-linter.toml --no-cache --no-logo
scripts.format: biome check --write . && uv run ruff format viqui
